title: Structural beam installed before consent was issued; NTF correct; appeal judgment attached (locality truncated in record)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE, Building Act 2004): comparative test only; not an Alberta case; no Alberta applicability asserted
document_type: MBIE determination under Building Act 2004 s188 (regulator decision on an individual matter); not an applicant's alternative-solution file

facts.text: Owners installed a new structural beam across a garage door opening; the authority had processed a consent application but did not issue the consent because some fees were unpaid.
The building work had already been carried out before the consent was granted and issued.

Decision: authority correct to refuse building consent 468097 because the work was already carried out, and correct to issue the notice to fix because the work breached s40; remedies appropriate (16 December 2022).
Practicability test under s41(1)(c): a consent could practicably have been obtained in advance.
